name: Fine coastal raster (anchoring)
source: OpenStreetMap land polygons via geo-maps earth-lands-100m 0.6.0 (npm @geo-maps/earth-lands-100m, package SHA-1 bcee1e6ce052d9c57bc7a2aa3b39912aaaf43c41, about 100 m accuracy). Map data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0, openstreetmap.org/copyright.
layout: coast.bin: 'LCHC', uint32 version, uint32 cells_per_degree, uint32 mixed_count; uint8 index[rows][columns] (row 0 = northernmost, column 0 = 180W; 0 water, 1 land, 2 mixed); uint32 offset, uint32 size per mixed tile in index order; zlib-deflated payloads of 120 x 120 bits (rows north to south, bits west to east, MSB first; 1 = land).
processing: Land if the cell centre is inside a land polygon; lakes filled. Not for navigation.
